subject: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:05:00Z
Subject: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Hi Alex - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + a few follow-ups so we can size pricing and recommend the right context-length tier:

Call recap (2 bullets):
- Primary use: customer support assistant + internal knowledge search powering multi-turn summarization and citation (mix of short prompts + multi-document context).
- Success metric: reduce average handle time and improve accuracy on citation-sensitive responses.

Requests / next steps I mentioned on the call:
1) Can you confirm average prompt tokens and average completion tokens - rough ballpark is fine (we typically ask for mean and 90th pct).
2) What percent of requests need expanded context windows (8k vs 32k vs 128k)? If you don't know exact %, an estimate split is helpful (e.g., 70% 8k, 25% 32k, 5% 128k).
3) Target unit economics / budget: is there a target $/1M tokens or an annual budget range you're trying to hit? This helps us propose reserved vs hosted sizing.

I've attached a short profiling template to capture sample distributions (avg prompt/completion, tail percentiles) - if you can fill and return, our SEs will run a quick cost estimate.

Attachments: [Attachment: context-length-profiling-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Quick ask: can you reply with (A) avg prompt tokens, (B) avg completion tokens, (C) % for each context tier, and (D) any target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range?

Thanks - I'll loop in Jordan (solutions) to schedule a short profiling session once we have the numbers.

- Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Marissa - thanks for the recap, appreciate the template. Quick answers below (high level for now):

A) Avg prompt tokens: ~220 tokens (we see some short prompts at ~50, many at ~200-300).
B) Avg completion tokens: ~480 tokens (typical replies + some structured bullet outputs). 90th pct ~1,800 tokens.
C) Context tier split (estimate): 8k: ~75%, 32k: ~20%, 128k: ~5% (the 128k requests are rare but critical for enterprise docs ingestion).
D) Budget: initial pilot budget is $5k- $10k/month; if we get good performance and accuracy, we can expand to ~$50k/mo in year 2. We don't have a strict $/1M tokens target but would prefer to see options under $40- $60 per 1M tokens for production.

Happy to share a small sample of anonymized prompts if that helps - I can send a CSV.

- Alex Turner
Head of AI Product, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme - pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Thanks Alex - really helpful. Based on your numbers I sketched a conservative ballpark so you have something to evaluate quickly. This is a rough working estimate - we'll finalize after we run your sample through profiling.

Ballpark unit economics (per 1M tokens consumed by the model; includes infer compute + infra + ops):
- 8k context (most requests): $28- $42 per 1M tokens
- 32k context: $48- $75 per 1M tokens
- 128k context: $120- $180 per 1M tokens

Notes: these ranges assume standard quantized variants and workload-aware batching. If you commit to reserved capacity (monthly), we can tighten those ranges by ~20-30% depending on commit and concurrency profile.

Suggested next steps:
- If you can share the CSV of sample prompts (anonymized) we'll run a quick token-distribution and tail analysis.
- Jordan (SE) can do a 45-min profiling session to validate the 90th pct/caching opportunities and recommend batching/quantization profiles.
- If the numbers look good, we'll put together a pilot proposal (3 months) with reserved pricing band and SLA notes.

I attached a one-pager with the above ballparks and an example unit-econ calc.

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing-ballpark-8k-32k-128k.pdf (pdf)]

Would you be available for a profiling call Tuesday or Wednesday next week?

Alex - Jordan here from Solutions. Thanks for the initial numbers, those are perfect for a first pass. I've penciled a 45-minute profiling session and a short SE checklist for next steps:

Proposed SE session (agenda):
- 10m: confirm sample distribution and anonymization
- 20m: run token-distribution and prefix-caching analysis live (we'll demo how many tokens we can save with KV caching)
- 10m: discuss batching/concurrency and reservation sizing
- 5m: next steps and pilot timeline

Availability: Tue 2026-08-17 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2026-08-18 14:00-15:00 PT. Which works for you?

I attached a quick CSV I generated from a similar customer to show the kind of breakdown we'll produce (avg, median, 90th, top tails). If you can send your CSV ahead of the call that'll speed things up.
